title: Axolotl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Puddle floor -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#4dd0e1" opacity="0.35"/>
  
  <!-- Tail (behind body) -->
  <path d="M 72 62 Q 88 55 85 45 Q 82 38 75 42" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 72 62 Q 88 55 85 45" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Left leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d="M 40 72 Q 30 65 22 55" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="21" cy="53" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#f06292"/>
  
  <!-- Right leg (planted) -->
  <path d="M 58 74 Q 62 82 64 86" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="87" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f06292"/>
  
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#f8bbd0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="20" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Belly lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#fce4ec"/>
  
  <!-- Left arm (waving up) -->
  <path d="M 34 58 Q 22 50 18 40" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="4.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left hand -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="38" r="4" fill="#f06292"/>
  <line x1="17" y1="38" x2="12" y2="32" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="17" y1="38" x2="15" y2="31" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="17" y1="38" x2="20" y2="32" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Right arm (out to side) -->
  <path d="M 66 58 Q 78 60 84 56" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="4.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="55" r="4" fill="#f06292"/>
  <line x1="85" y1="55" x2="90" y2="50" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="85" y1="55" x2="91" y2="54" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="85" y1="55" x2="89" y2="59" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#f8bbd0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#f48fb1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blushes -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="48" r="4" fill="#f06292" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="48" r="4" fill="#f06292" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes (happy dancing squint) -->
  <path d="M 38 40 Q 41 36 44 40" stroke="#7b1fa2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 56 40 Q 59 36 62 40" stroke="#7b1fa2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Mouth (happy open) -->
  <path d="M 44 48 Q 50 54 56 48" stroke="#7b1fa2" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Gills left side -->
  <path d="M 29 34 Q 18 24 12 28" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 28 40 Q 16 38 14 45" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 29 46 Q 20 48 17 55" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Gills right side -->
  <path d="M 71 34 Q 82 24 88 28" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 72 40 Q 84 38 86 45" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 71 46 Q 80 48 83 55" stroke="#f06292" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Gill feathery tips -->
  <circle cx="12" cy="27" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="45" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="56" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="27" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="45" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="56" r="2" fill="#e91e63"/>
  
  <!-- Music notes floating -->
  <g fill="#ffeb3b">
    <path d="M 78 20 L 78 12 L 84 10 L 84 18" stroke="#ffeb3b" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="77" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#ffeb3b"/>
    <circle cx="83" cy="18" r="2.5" fill="#ffeb3b"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#4dd0e1">
    <path d="M 14 18 L 14 12 L 19 11 L 19 17" stroke="#4dd0e1" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="13" cy="18" r="2" fill="#4dd0e1"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="17" r="2" fill="#4dd0e1"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <path d="M 8 68 Q 4 66 2 70" stroke="#f8bbd0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M 90 72 Q 94 70 96 74" stroke="#f8bbd0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
